'''Republic Droids''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufacturing company. It was formed from the remnants of the droid manufacturing equipment that the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] bought during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
